title: Benchmarking Reasoning Reliability in Artificial Intelligence Models for Energy-System Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Testing the model's ability to reject false premises, avoid unsupported claims, and maintain factual integrity when presented with misleading or fabricated inputs within energy-system analytical scenarios.
Evaluating the stability of model reasoning when prompts are rephrased using authoritative, adversarial, or persuasive personas to measure the model's susceptibility to social or linguistic pressure.
